title: Planned change: re-sorting keeps groups open; a new date still closes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has at least two unpaid bills.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Unpaid Invoices" in the left list.
  3. Open vendor Y's group.
  4. Click the "Amount" column heading.
  5. Read vendor Y's group.
  6. Set the date chip to yesterday.
  7. Read vendor Y's group.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • PRD v12, 2. Feature Overview, What changes for existing users, quoted: “Re-sorting A/R Collection or A/P Unpaid Invoices no longer collapses the open groups.”

Step 5:

  • PRD v12, S2-R9, quoted: “Re-sorting never changes which groups are expanded or collapsed (Story 4).”
  • Step 5 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): Vendor Y's group is still open, its lines in the new order.
  • Step 7 (unchanged from before the release): Changing the date still closes every group.
  • Related existing case: S4-13 C715366 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715366); S4-14 C715367 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715367). This case checks the same planned change from the before-the-release side.

Why this matters: Sorting must not lose the user's place; a new date is still a new report.

SOURCE: A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, 2. Feature Overview, What changes for existing users; S2-R9. V1 behaviour before the change: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingCollectionReport.vue:396-397; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApUnpaidInvoicesReport.vue:363-373.

This is the expected behaviour as per the A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, 2. Feature Overview, What changes for existing users, S2-R9, for epic SV-11315; the V1 behaviour it changes is recorded in AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-112). Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
